name: print-social-digital-marketing-agency-banner-orange-organic-blob-frame
title: 'Digital Marketing Agency' banner template with an orange field, organic blob photo frame and white base
whatItMeans: Simple and adaptable; the organic blob photo frame gives an otherwise plain corporate banner a friendly, modern touch.
whatItIs: A wide banner split between a solid orange left field with 'AGENCY' label, bold 'DIGITAL MARKETING AGENCY' title, body copy and contact icons, and a white right field with a large pink triangular-organic blob labelled 'Product picture or your logo'.
techniques: Split a banner into a solid colour field and a white field.
Use an organic blob shape as a placeholder photo frame.
Keep contact details as a simple icon-plus-text row.

vocabulary.definition: An irregular rounded shape used to crop or hold a photo.
A template banner with generic labels meant to be replaced.
